list.name: List notes
list.description: List files in the tenant's notes folder. Read-only.

read.name: Read a note
read.description: Read one note by exact relative path. There is deliberately no search: the caller must already know the path.

publish.name: Publish a note
publish.description: Copy a note to the tenant's published folder. Outward-facing, so it goes through the approval gate.

balance.name: Budget balance
balance.description: Show this tenant's budget cap and what is left. Read-only.

charge.name: Charge the budget
charge.description: Record a spend against the tenant's hard budget cap. Goes through the approval gate and the cap is re-checked when it runs.
